_meta.name: PanelCompare SMM panel price index
_meta.description: Daily minimum, quartile, median and maximum price per 1000 units for each tracked SMM service, computed across every active offering in the catalogue, with the cheapest and dearest listing within ten times of the median (quotable_min/quotable_max) — the figures to quote; min and max are the raw extremes. The current day’s row is recomputed through the day; computed_at says when.
